evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, symbols, contexts, values and figure briefs are newly authored. The seven mapped P2 leaves ground whole-equation checks, dimensionless coefficients, unknown exponents and multi-factor base-unit comparisons. Their complete question contexts were reviewed so that later-topic applications are used only as supplied unit-analysis settings.

question_set_contract.difficulty_progression: direct prior-lesson retrieval, recognition of a homogeneous sum, recognition of a dimensionless coefficient, matching an unknown exponent, a three-stage product check, a supplied thermal-unit comparison, then a mixed derived-unit and homogeneity application

questions.prompt: From the previous lesson, use J = N m and N = kg m s^-2 to express the joule entirely in SI base units.
A quantity x has unit m, v has unit m s^-1, a has unit m s^-2 and t has unit s. Which equation is homogeneous?

A supplied model is F = C rho A u^2. Force F has unit kg m s^-2, density rho has unit kg m^-3, area A has unit m^2 and speed u has unit m s^-1. Which unit must C have for the equation to be homogeneous?
A geometric model is D = Mh^n/w. D has unit kg m^-3, M has unit kg, h and w each have unit m, and n is an integer. Which value of n makes the equation homogeneous?
A detector output S has SI base-unit form kg s^-3. A proposed model is S = C rho u^3, where C has no unit, rho has unit kg m^-3 and u has unit m s^-1.

figure.purpose: Organise the supplied quantities for a multi-factor homogeneity check without performing the simplification
figure.brief: Create an original Cambridge-inspired black-and-white rectangular detector model card. Show S = C rho u^3 and a three-row unit key: S in kg s^-3, rho in kg m^-3, u in m s^-1. State C has no unit. Do not simplify any term or state whether the model is homogeneous.
figure.alt_text: A detector model card gives an equation and the unsimplified SI base units of its quantities.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Determine the SI base-unit form of rho u^3. Show the powers before simplifying.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Use your answer in (a) to decide whether the proposed model is homogeneous. Justify the decision by comparing both sides.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: A second proposal replaces u^3 with u^2 while keeping all other quantities unchanged. Decide whether this second equation is homogeneous and identify the mismatched base-unit form.

questions.prompt: A thermal test uses the supplied model E = kV(T1 - T2)/L. The units are [E] = kg m^2 s^-2, [k] = kg s^-2 K^-1, [V] = m^3, [T1 - T2] = K and [L] = m.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Substitute the supplied SI base units into the right-hand side and simplify them completely.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: State whether the supplied model is homogeneous.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: A colleague proposes dividing the right-hand side by an additional time t, where [t] = s. Determine the new right-hand unit and explain why the altered equation passes or fails the homogeneity check.

questions.prompt: A surface-transfer meter reports a rate S with unit kg s^-3. Its proposed model is S = CP/A, where C has no unit, P is power and A is area.

figure.purpose: Present the linked derived-unit and homogeneity task as one readable model card
figure.brief: Create an original Cambridge-inspired black-and-white rectangular surface-transfer meter card. Show reported rate S: kg s^-3, proposed model S = CP/A, C: no unit, P: power and A: area. Include a second unchecked proposal S = CP/L with L: length. Do not show base-unit expansions, ticks or conclusions.
figure.alt_text: A surface-transfer meter card shows two unchecked equations and identifies power, area, length and a unitless coefficient.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Use energy = force x distance and power = energy/time to derive the SI base-unit form of P.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Use [A] = m^2 and your answer in (a) to test whether S = CP/A is homogeneous.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: A second proposal is S = CP/L, where [L] = m. Determine its right-hand base-unit form and state the precise conclusion supported by the check.
